mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO place (place_id, place_name, latitude, longitude, address, phone) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{placeName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{address}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT place_id, place_name, latitude, longitude, score_sum, score_count, address, phone FROM place WHERE score_count > 5 ORDER BY (score_sum / score_count) DESC, score_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT p.place_id, p.place_name, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.score_sum, p.score_count, p.address, p.phone FROM place p JOIN place_in_theme pit ON pit.place_id = p.place_id WHERE pit.theme_id = #{themeId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.score_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE p.score_sum / p.score_count END DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO place_in_theme (theme_id, place_id, editor_id) VALUES (#{themeId}, #{placeId}, #{editorId})
INSERT INTO place_score (place_id, editor_id, score) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{editorId}, #{score}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = #{score}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE place SET score_sum = COALESCE((SELECT SUM(score) FROM place_score WHERE place_id = #{placeId}), 0), score_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_score WHERE place_id = #{placeId}) WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_in_theme WHERE theme_id = #{themeId} AND place_id = #{placeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE pit FROM place_in_theme pit JOIN theme t ON t.theme_id = pit.theme_id WHERE pit.theme_id = #{themeId} AND pit.place_id = #{placeId} AND (pit.editor_id = #{editorId} OR t.editor_id = #{editorId})
mapper.select: SELECT editor_id FROM place_in_theme WHERE theme_id = #{themeId} AND place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_in_theme WHERE theme_id = #{themeId} AND editor_id = #{editorId}
